strings: Repair it. Your system has good years left.
A repair is the smart money move right now. We will fix it, check the rest of the system, and tell you honestly how many years you can expect.
Repair for now, and start planning.
A repair makes sense today, but your system is getting close. Ask for a free replacement quote so you can pick a new system on your schedule, not in a heat wave.
Replacing will likely save you money.
Between the age, the repair cost, and your bills, a new system will probably cost less over the next five years. A free in-home quote shows your real numbers, with no pressure.
